newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market inches up in thin interest.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market inches up in thin interest.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed Monday marginally up from the Friday's closing amid a thin interest in trading due to the summer holiday period, traders said.
Operators said they did not expect major changes on Tuesday, as investors were still in a wait-and-see mood.
"The market will stay relatively stable, with no significant up or down movements," one trader said. The buying mood might rebound by the end of the week, he added.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 261 to 75 on Monday, while prices for 192 stocks marked time.
Three independent indices, computed by securities companies and based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched up from Friday's levels.
The VAB-RA all-share index went up by one percent to 6,505.1 points, BIG-OTC rose 0.01 percent to 4,937.14 and CAS-RQ grew 0.07 percent to 1,093 points.
Oil refineries and cement makers were stable throughout the day, but still in the investors' limelight. Bearings makers were also in the focus gaining ground under buying pressure.
Arpechim oil refinery closed flat at 42,000 lei.
Astra Romana, another refinery, added 300 lei closing firmer at 2,300 with traders saying it might extend gains in the coming days provided investors' interest stayed high.

Bearing makers Rulmenti Alexandria and Rulmenti Barlad closed 1,000 lei and 2,500 lei higher at 41,000 and 31,000 respectively. Some operators expected an uptrend of bearings makers prices on the back of growing foreign interest.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03. ($=7,158 lei)
